name: GL_COA_MAP_SEGMENT_RULES_INT
description: This table is an interface table used to load of chart of accounts mapping definitions and segment rules into the application.

columns.name: GROUP_NUMBER
columns.description: Chart of accounts mapping interface group identifier.

columns.name: ROW_NUMBER
columns.description: Chart of accounts mapping interface row number.

columns.name: MAPPING_NAME
columns.description: User-defined chart of accounts definition name.

columns.name: FROM_CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS_CODE
columns.description: The source chart of accounts structure instance code for which mappings are being imported.

columns.name: TO_CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS_CODE
columns.description: The target chart of accounts structure instance code for which mappings are being imported.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Chart of accounts definition description.

columns.name: IMPORT_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: The action that the import process must perform. Valid values are INSERT and DELETE.

columns.name: TARGET_SEGMENT_CODE
columns.description: Segment code of the target chart of accounts segment.

columns.name: MAPPING_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Mapping action for a segment rule. Valid values are ASSIGN_SINGLE_VALUE, COPY_VALUE_FROM_SOURCE, or USE_ROLLUP_RULES.

columns.name: TARGET_SEGMENT_VALUE
columns.description: Target segment value for Assign Single Value mapping.

columns.name: FIRST_SOURCE_SEGMENT_CODE
columns.description: First source chart of accounts segment code for which a segment rule needs to be defined.

columns.name: SECOND_SOURCE_SEGMENT_CODE
columns.description: Second source chart of accounts segment code for which a segment rule needs to be defined.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Code that indicates the import status of the mapping. Valid values are NEW, SUCCESS, and ERROR.

columns.name: IMPORT_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: Indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: The error message of the mappings that could not be imported. Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the interface load job that created the row. This column is used in internal processing only.
